prediction_provenance.input: Actual user detector outputs cached once; both trackers receive identical boxes/scores/classes and original frames.
prediction_provenance.edge_association: Virtual full-sized extents for association only; actual detector boxes are returned and retained.
prediction_provenance.edge_rebind: Consecutive actual-box IoU >= 0.5 at a frame edge, with a 0.15 margin over other eligible lost identities.
prediction_provenance.limitations: This tests immediate tracking and evidence retention, not reconstruction/grade accuracy or all physical identities.

scope: all visible fruit in full frame
evaluation_role: development pilot; existing video has been inspected during development
prediction_role: historical cached tracker outputs; not a fresh run of current production
